title: Evidence list loads with counts matching the seeded org's evidence records
preconditions: Logged in as a seeded test org admin
Org has a known, fixed number of evidence items across at least 2 statuses
steps: Log in as the seeded org admin
Read the total evidence count shown on the list header/stats card
expectedResult: Displayed total count equals the known seeded evidence record count for the org, and the list rows rendered match that count (pagination accounted for).

title: Upload dialog opens and closes cleanly without leaving residual UI state
steps: Confirm the dialog renders with file picker and control-mapping selector
Close the dialog via the close/cancel control without submitting
expectedResult: Dialog closes with no error toast and no orphaned backdrop/scroll-lock. Reopening shows a fresh, empty form with no leftover file selection or field values from the previous attempt.

title: Control mapping dropdown populates with controls from the org's active framework
preconditions: ISO 27001 framework activated for the project
steps: Open the Upload Evidence dialog on /evidence-management
expectedResult: Dropdown populates with a non-empty list of controls belonging to the project's active framework (e.g. ISO 27001 Annex A controls), with no loading spinner stuck and no empty-list error state.

title: Review queue shows pending items for the seeded org
preconditions: Seeded org has at least one evidence item in 'Pending Review' status
steps: Log in as a reviewer for the seeded org
Navigate to the evidence review queue (My Reviews)
expectedResult: The review queue lists the seeded pending item(s) with status 'Pending Review', correct title, and correct control mapping visible — queue is not empty and does not error.

title: Download link on an approved evidence item returns a working file
preconditions: Seeded org has at least one evidence item in 'Approved' status with an uploaded file
steps: Open an approved evidence item's detail page
Click the 'Download' link/button for the attached file
Confirm the file downloads or opens
expectedResult: A presigned download URL is issued and the file downloads successfully with the correct original filename; no 403/404/expired-link error is shown.

title: Filtering evidence list by framework returns non-empty results for a seeded org
preconditions: Seeded org has evidence mapped to controls under an activated framework (e.g. ISO 27001)
steps: Apply the framework filter and select the org's activated framework (e.g. ISO 27001)
expectedResult: The filtered list returns at least one evidence item mapped to that framework's controls; the list is not empty and no filter-related console/API error occurs.
